summary: Frontend-only verification of Populus logo bug fix. Confirmed the scales-of-justice logo (icon.png) renders correctly on BOTH the auth screen (testID='auth-logo', 120x120, centered above 'POPULUS' brand) and the home tab header (testID='home-logo', 52x52 in top-left of the black header). Both elements resolve to a valid in web preview with naturalWidth=1024, complete=true, HTTP 200 (350842 bytes) from https://vote-ui-polish.preview.emergentagent.com/assets/?unstable_path=./assets/images/icon.png. Anonymous login regression works: 9 feud cards rendered on home feed. Bug 'Non vedo il logo da nessuna parte' is resolved.

issues: home-logo rendered box is 48x48 while style declares 52x52 (likely due to the 2px borderWidth eating into the layout box). Visually fine but if exact 52 needed, wrap Image in a View or use width/height that accounts for the border. Non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — from an RN/Expo component (likely inside expo-router/react-native-safe-area-context or a Pressable). Not caused by the logo fix. Reference: emitted at runtime on auth->home transition.

action_items: None required for the logo bug — it is fully fixed.
Optional: investigate 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning (unrelated to this fix; likely third-party lib or a Pressable prop).
Optional: adjust home-logo sizing to compensate for the 2px border if pixel-perfect 52x52 is desired.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx and (tabs)/index.tsx correctly use Image from react-native with require('../assets/images/icon.png') — bundler resolves it and web preview serves the asset with HTTP 200.
Both Image tags have testID and resizeMode='contain' — good for testability and preserving aspect ratio.
adaptive-icon.png, favicon.png, icon.png are identical (350842 bytes) which is fine but a bit wasteful; consider generating adaptive-icon at correct foreground/background specs for Android.
seed_data_creation: None (used anonymous login with fresh nickname per run: retest<timestamp>)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo bug is verified fixed. Two <Image> instances (testID='auth-logo' 120x120 on auth screen; testID='home-logo' 52x52 in home tab header) both load icon.png successfully. Preview URL: https://vote-ui-polish.preview.emergentagent.com. Anonymous flow: tap [data-testid=auth-tab-anon], fill [data-testid=auth-anon-nickname-input], click [data-testid=auth-submit-button]. Note: first Playwright check for home-logo naturalWidth returned 0 due to a race condition — wait ~3-5s after home-screen loads before asserting on image dimensions.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: icon.png/splash-image.png existed in /app/frontend/assets/images/ but were only referenced by app.json (native OS launcher/splash) — never rendered inside the running app UI. Fix: added <Image source={require('../assets/images/icon.png')}> to auth.tsx header (120x120 above POPULUS brand) and to (tabs)/index.tsx header (52x52 left of POPULUS title). Both render correctly in the Expo web preview and are served with 200 status.
